_comment: Partial realm import for realm jcsc-oauth: the two Splunk roles plus the
s4k_hs_access is a marker role. s4k_hs_admin and s4k_hs_user are COMPOSITE
roles that include it, so granting either automatically grants access and
there is only one role for the deny condition to test. Nobody is assigned
Apply with: Realm Settings -> Action -> Partial import, or via
keycloak-config-cli / the Keycloak Operator's KeycloakRealmImport CRD.
Authenticator provider IDs and config key names are stable across recent
Keycloak but are NOT guaranteed across major versions. Import into a test
realm first and compare against a UI-built flow before trusting it.
This grants nothing by itself. After importing you must still bind the
flow to the Splunk client: Clients -> splunk-hs -> Advanced ->
Authentication flow overrides -> Browser Flow = splunk-browser.

realm.name: s4k_hs_access
realm.description: Marker role gating login to the splunk-hs client. Do not assign directly; granted via the composite roles below.

realm.name: s4k_hs_admin
realm.description: Splunk administrators. Maps to the Splunk admin role.

realm.name: s4k_hs_user
realm.description: Standard Splunk users. Maps to the Splunk user role.

authenticationFlows.description: Browser flow for the Splunk SAML client: denies users lacking splunk-access
Certificate authentication. Swap x509 for the form authenticator if not using client certs.
Conditional deny: runs only when the user lacks splunk-access

config.error_message: Your account is not authorized for Splunk. Request the s4k_hs_admin or s4k_hs_user role.
